connector.name: Elster MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Drive the German tax portal ELSTER via Puppeteer: submit UStVA, prepare EUER/ESt, sync inbox.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package elster-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lukasschwarz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ELSTER_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Path to a config.json that holds all settings below. Recommended.

env.name: ELSTER_PFX_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to your ELSTER certificate (.pfx).

env.name: ELSTER_TAX_NUMBER
env.description: Your Steuernummer in the format issued by your Finanzamt.

env.name: ELSTER_STATE_CODE
env.description: Two-digit ELSTER federal-state code of your Finanzamt.

env.name: ELSTER_EST_SKIP_EUR
env.description: If 1, skip the EUER pre-hook in ESt sessions.
